studies.notes: The main analysis retained in the extraction is image-text creativity grades pooled across themes (s1_image_text_hat_vs_hi_no_covariates; PDF p. 8, Table 3, column (1)); the paper identifies image-text grades as primary (PDF pp. 6-7, Sections 2.2 and 3.2). No distinct-person analyzed total or arm counts are printed for this analysis or the retained text-only analysis. Table 2 counts submissions across repeated tasks, and Table 3 counts individual/team-idea observations, including the separate Training cohort. Appendix B.2 additionally describes missing images and evaluator grades without stating the number of distinct people affected. The screening form’s analyzed totals were derived; no subtraction, summation, division of submissions, or inference from model observations is used here. Table D.1 reports DAT counts by major without an S1 total or breakdown by treatment. All reported counts in this check refer to people; HHT counts people rather than teams. Read the complete markdown, including appendices and references, and checked the cited PDF pages with pymupdf. The separate Supplementary Material named in Appendix E (PDF p. 21), including the individual/team-level robustness analysis in Table S4, is not on file. Requests through the Elsevier Article Retrieval API and the article DOI, using User-Agent atlas-screening/0.1, both failed with WinError 10013; no additional supplement count could be confirmed. PDF page numbers equal printed page numbers. Quotes retain PDF characters; line wrapping is normalized except in the Table D.3 quotation.
